description: This Java source file defines the KamonHistogram class, which implements a Histogram interface using Kamon metrics library for recording and managing histogram data. The class provides methods for tagging, resetting, recording values, and retrieving recorded data, specifically designed for monitoring purposes within a distributed system.

classes.name: KamonHistogram
classes.description: An implementation of the Histogram interface using Kamon for collecting and managing histogram metrics, supporting tagging, reset, record, and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: newHistogram
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new Histogram instance with a specified name.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Returns a new Histogram instance with an additional tag key-value pair added.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Returns a new Histogram instance with multiple tags added or updated.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag by key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns the unmodifiable map of all tags associated with this histogram.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Attempts to reset the histogram's snapshot and logs the operation; returns true if successful.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a value into the histogram.

methods.name: getRecordedValues
methods.description: Retrieves all recorded histogram bucket values as an array of Longs.

methods.name: addBucketValuesToList
methods.description: Helper method to add all values from a histogram bucket to the list of recorded values.

methods.name: getSnapshot
methods.description: Obtains a snapshot of the histogram, optionally resetting it.

methods.name: getKamonInternalHistogram
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the Kamon histogram instance with the current tags.
